title: Transport both exceptional cocycles to prescribed finite stages
statement: Fix D,l,Omega,X,Y,f,c as in [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data] and a coefficient-compatible exceptional system S at the auxiliary small closure. For finite coefficient indices E less than or equal to L less than or equal to M in Omega, the actual finiteLeft and finiteRight functors, with their actual finiteLeftScalar and finiteRightScalar comparisons, satisfy CoefficientCocycleCondition for the prescribed chosen stage associators on X and Y, in reversed order for the right functors.

proof.text: Apply rational_scalar_cocycles to the small coefficient-field models, their three inclusion maps, and coefficientInclusion_laws. Use the uniqueness characterization of each chosen associator to identify it with the literal scalarAssociator. Equality transport of both equations gives the stated pair of finite cocycles. The proof packages the component equations before specialization to avoid repeatedly expanding rational constructible category definitions.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_scalar_cocycles (c : Compactification f)
    (S : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.System l (AuxiliaryClosure.{u} l) D hl (f := f))
    {E L M : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M) :
    CoefficientCocycleCondition
    (finiteLeft D l hl Ω X f c S E) (finiteLeft D l hl Ω X f c S L)
    (finiteLeft D l hl Ω X f c S M)
    (finiteLeftScalar D l hl Ω X f c S E L h)
    (finiteLeftScalar D l hl Ω X f c S L M k)
    (finiteLeftScalar D l hl Ω X f c S E M (h.trans k))
    (associator l Ω X E L M h k) (associator l Ω Y E L M h k) ∧
    CoefficientCocycleCondition
    (finiteRight D l hl Ω X f c S E) (finiteRight D l hl Ω X f c S L)
    (finiteRight D l hl Ω X f c S M)
    (finiteRightScalar D l hl Ω X f c S E L h)
    (finiteRightScalar D l hl Ω X f c S L M k)
    (finiteRightScalar D l hl Ω X f c S E M (h.trans k))
    (associator l Ω Y E L M h k) (associator l Ω X E L M h k)
